# MedLit Evidence Appraisal

MedLit is an AI-assisted reading aid for structured scientific-literature appraisal. A user supplies a PubMed, PMC, DOI, or supported preprint identifier and their own AI-provider key.

## What reports contain

- Explicit full-text or abstract-only source coverage
- Design-specific, framework-aligned appraisal questions
- Exact supporting passages matched against retrieved article text
- Evidence-linked PICO fields and PDF page or section locations
- Low, some-concerns, high, unclear, or not-applicable domain judgments
- Methods and disclosure extraction
- Bounded reference-identifier and indexed retraction-update checks
- Versioned saved reports, comparison tables, reviewer corrections, collections, tags, notes, backups, and portable read-only links
- DOI/PMID/RIS/BibTeX/Zotero batch queues plus local PubMed search and update checks

## Boundaries

MedLit does not determine truth, scientific accuracy, clinical applicability, or treatment safety. It does not replace official appraisal instruments, peer review, retraction databases, source reading, or domain expertise. Metadata-only records are not analyzed. Paywalls are not bypassed.

Public documentation: `/methodology`, `/faq`, `/privacy`, and `/terms`.

## Practical guides
- [Critical appraisal of a research paper](https://medlit.theredko.com/guides/critical-appraisal): A practical way to examine study design, source coverage, bias and applicability before relying on a finding.
- [Review a PubMed paper with AI](https://medlit.theredko.com/guides/pubmed-paper-review): Bring a PubMed link or PMID into MedLit, inspect the available source, and create an appraisal with your own AI provider.
- [Use your own AI API key for research appraisal](https://medlit.theredko.com/guides/bring-your-own-ai): Connect OpenAI, Claude or Gemini directly, choose a model, and understand what MedLit sends and stores.
- [Prepare a journal club paper review](https://medlit.theredko.com/guides/journal-club): Turn a paper into a structured discussion of its question, methods, findings and remaining uncertainty.

## Additional reading guides
- [How to critically appraise a randomized controlled trial](https://medlit.theredko.com/guides/randomized-trial-critical-appraisal): A reading guide for medical students and journal clubs: examine a trial’s question, allocation, missing data, outcome reporting and applicability.
- [Can you critically appraise a paper from its abstract?](https://medlit.theredko.com/guides/abstract-vs-full-text): Understand what an abstract-only AI paper review can support, what it leaves unanswered, and when you need the full text.

## Related products and initiatives

These are distinct products and initiatives connected through Redko and founder Anya Ozmen. Product accounts and privacy choices are separate.

- [Redko](https://www.theredko.com/products): Product design, software development and AI services.
- [Redko Labs](https://www.theredko.com/RedkoLabs): An incubator for founders working in impact AI and deep tech.
- [MedLit](https://medlit.theredko.com/about): Read research critically and inspect the evidence behind an appraisal.
- [Synaptik](https://synaptik.theredko.com/about): Research-informed cognitive practice and everyday wellbeing activities.
- [Gameer](https://www.gameer.io/about): Play, create and share games with AI tools.
- [Redvest](https://www.redvest.app/about): Financial education and investing tools.

Redko Labs currently uses its public Vercel address while the Redko domain migration is in progress.
